notes.title: [1.2.0] Game Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thanks to your support, "Strange Tales of Mid-Lake Pavilion" has successfully rolled out the 1.2.0 version update.

The main contents of this update include:

1.UI interface and interaction improvements.

2.Addition of Japanese voiceovers for some characters. 

3.Improvements in character illustrations and backgrounds. 

Using the Kitaro as an example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41391697/2372f758fadf43dbfa1e140487d667a1280a6677.png[/img]

Some 3D modeled images have been replaced with hand-drawn styles:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41391697/d21e052ddd81c79b05967efe825fbbcebbb97a7d.png[/img]

Additional details have been added that were not present before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41391697/4058456533f149ff5c32eb03cac4d84046d78d1b.png[/img]

I am deeply grateful for all your support. Game updates and optimizations will continue in the future. Please continue to offer your valuable feedback.

If you are interested in the progress of my game development, please follow my [url=https://twitter.com/chiikun1996]X account[/url]. Thank you!
